audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty is already framed correctly: Lux wins the poke war early (levels 1-5), Zilean's warps and Chronoshift take over at 2+ items.
audit.why: Lux's Q/E poke (1175/1100 range) outranges Zilean's 900-range bomb and 550-range E early; Zilean has no answer until double Time Warp and Chronoshift come online.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Light Binding as the key cooldown but carried no actual number, failing lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT.
audit.why: Light Binding is a flat 10s cooldown at all ranks; Zilean's E Time Warp is a flat 15s cooldown. Both are concrete numbers the reader can play around.
audit.corrected: Added both cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions Prismatic Barrier (W) absorbing Zilean's burst window or Illumination's auto-reset as the tell that precedes Lux's real combo.
audit.why: Both are flagged in missingInteractions as applicable to this matchup and are not stated anywhere in current text.
audit.corrected: Folded the shield point into report[5] (Key Ability Interactions) and the auto-reset tell into breakdown.trading's bad-trade clause.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and the combo never starts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Time Warp banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Track Lux’s Light Binding: Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and the combo never starts. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Light Binding: minion-block it or the combo never starts. Prismatic Barrier eats your burst — force it out before you commit.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the carry, W, Q the stun, walk — the double-bomb chunk that started as chip. Bad trade: Spending the R on a survivable catch — the undo insures deaths, not discomfort.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the carry, W, Q the stun, walk — the double-bomb chunk that started as chip. Bad trade: stepping up while Illumination winds up — that's her burst tell, not the cast.
